## Payment Application

The part of a Bill Payment applied to one bill: `billNo` (the bill's number, as text) and `amountMinor` (integer cents).

```ts
import { PaymentApplication } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-payments';
```

Bill Payment holds `applications = containsMany(PaymentApplication)`. Its `totalMinor` is the sum of the amounts, and each application with a positive amount becomes a debit to Accounts Payable `2000` tagged with the bill number. When the payment posts, the same batch calls `Bill.applyPayment` on each named bill with this amount, which refuses more than the bill has open.

### Non-goals
Not a link to the Bill card: the bill is named by its number. No discount taken or write-off amount per application. Amounts are integer cents (`…Minor` fields) with no currency field; the ledger is single-currency.

### Example
Paying bill `B-2026-03-G` in full.
